method: Every actor has one preselected case. Work items identify missing claim-level audit and causal evidence, not inferred influence. A completed task requires source opening, date/definition matching, independent outcome corroboration and documented review. Two cases now include explicitly sourced dated event cross-checks. Completed tasks cover source corroboration at their stated scope, not comprehensive independent claim-level audits. Russia, EU and India now have directly opened dated source confirmations for scoped milestone/baseline claims. Source opening does not establish independent performance or attribution. Five-sphere baseline/follow-up assessments are descriptive research assessments; comparable units do not imply influence attribution. Actor-specific alternative explanations and discriminating measurements are preregistered research hypotheses, not verified causal findings.

items.title: 2023 Camp David trilateral cooperation commitments
items.knownObservation: August 18, 2023: US, Japan and South Korea committed to activate trilateral real-time DPRK missile-warning data sharing. November 2023: ministers reported final-stage testing. December 19, 2023: all three governments announced full activation following operational tests. This is a documented change from prior separate US bilateral data-sharing arrangements, not proof of unilateral US influence.

claimLevelVerification.finding: Japanese defense ministry and South Korean Yonhap reporting both confirm activation of trilateral real-time DPRK missile-warning sharing on 19 December 2023. This confirms an announced operational activation, not independently observed system performance or US causal attribution.

items.title: 2023 Beijing agreement to resume Saudi-Iran diplomatic relations
items.knownObservation: Saudi Arabia and Iran agreed in Beijing on 10 March 2023 to resume diplomatic ties and reopen missions within two months. Iran reopened its embassy in Riyadh in June 2023; Saudi Arabia's embassy in Tehran resumed operations in August 2023. The embassy reopening milestones occurred after the agreement, but beyond its initial two-month target.

items.title: Russia-Belarus Union State security guarantees treaty
items.knownObservation: Treaty signed 6 December 2024, ratified by Russia in February 2025 and entered into force 13 March 2025. Prior to signature, Belarus had already supported Russia's 2022 invasion, hosted Russian forces and missile systems, and engaged in Union State security cooperation. The treaty codifies security commitments; it does not establish that these earlier behaviors resulted from the treaty.

items.title: EU–Moldova Security and Defence Partnership
items.knownObservation: EU–Moldova Security and Defence Partnership signed May 2024. Moldova's foreign ministry confirmed in May 2025 that EUPM assistance included contributions to a crisis-management center concept, cybersecurity agency assistance and equipment; mission began in May 2023. A November 2025 joint dialogue recommitted to cybersecurity and hybrid-threat cooperation. These are operational cooperation observations, not demonstrated incremental outcomes caused by the 2024 partnership.
